items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I loved their piano player, Freddie Kreitzer. In fact, I even called him here. I got loaded one night here in New York, and called him in Florida.

ctx.x: tunes that night than any band I ever heard in my life, going from one to the next. I loved their piano player, Freddie Kreitzer. In fact, I even called him here. I got loaded one night here in New York, and called him in Florida. He didn't believe me at all! He says, "You mean, that Jazz piano player?" "Yup, that's me." He didn't think it was me.
What was it you liked about the band most?
